# PC Keybinds
Shift - Run
Ctrl - Cam-lock
V - Cam-lock mode
C - Crawl
Backspace - Drop
R - Reload
E/Q - UFO Up-Down
Shift + Motorcycle - Wheelie
T + Police car - Siren/gate open
Right Mouse/Z - Scope
F - Punch/Detonate C4

# Mobile Keybinds
Drag items from inventory to drop
Customize touch layout in settings

# Controller Keybinds
L3 - run
Y - Crawl/UFO Up
B - Punch/UFO Down
X - Reload
D-Pad ⬆️ - Scope
D-Pad ➡️ - Cam-lock
D-Pad ⬅️ - Cam-lock mode

# Private Servers
As owner of a private server you unlock many commands to control the game.
/cmd - Terminal
/cmds - List commands

games.name: Final Stand: Remastered
Corridor
games.desc:
You are in a corridor. It will only end when all anomalies are reported; you are the one who does this job.

[⚠]: - The game may sometimes have jumpscares and tense moments. If you have any problems with this, be careful while playing!

[CONTROLS]: 
Shift to Run for PC
L2 to Sprint for CONSOLE

[GUIDE]:
Any anomaly seen in the corridor counts.
- Report all anomalies at the end of the corridor to progress.
- Don't let anyone pass.

Game inspired by The Exit 8 on Steam.

games.name: REALISTIC HOOD TESTING
games.desc:
Game Is in Alpha Stage – Expect Bugs

This game is a "hood" gun testing experience focused on firearms, vehicles, and environments. It is not a full-fledged game but rather a casual and experimental test space. This game is inspired by "REALISTIC HOOD GUN TEST," the Original "REALISTIC HOOD," and MiscGunTest. 

[How To Play]
- Choose from 150+ guns and test them all out!
- Visit the Firearm Store to customize your weapons with Optics, Lights, Lasers, Foregrips, and more!
- Spawn with a randomized loadout and engage in PvP battles against other players.
- Experiment with a variety of weapons, each featuring different calibers and mechanics.

Supported Platforms: Mobile, Tablet, PC, Xbox, and PlayStation
